summary: Completed the Alembic-only rework as one clean commit c84c51952fe119efb89360a08adffa335322b886. Fresh-process recovery now replays a durable quiesced-observation receipt into the exact missing journal event before snapshot progression; terminal not-running progress now resumes exact stale control removal with inventory binding, active-PID rejection, directory fsync, and absence readback. The same strict path also rehashes resumed progress correctly, verifies authorized RESET_STARTED phase deltas, and completes setup-state cleanup after a durable recovery receipt. The independent OS-process matrix covers header, request-unaccepted, accepted-draining, old-PID/receipt, receipt/event, snapshot/probe, reset, and quarantine/restore prefixes while retaining fail-closed unknown-delta and checkpoint-negative behavior.
